items.name: San Cristobal Open Sucre 2026
items.information:
Welcome to the fifth official tournament in Sucre, the capital of Bolivia. This competition will take place at San Cristóbal School's sports hall. The tournament is open to all ages and to everyone who wishes to participate. For more information about the competition, please visit the following tab. [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanCristobalOpenSucre2026#68653-faq-pmf)

Bienvenidos al quinto torneo oficial en Sucre, capital de Bolivia. Esta competencia se realizará en el Coliseo del Colegio San Cristóbal. El torneo está abierto a todas las edades y a todas las personas que deseen participar. Para más información sobre la competencia, visita la siguiente pestaña. items.name: Gurizão em Osório 2026

venue.name: AABB Osório
venue.address: R. Lateral, A, 38 - Albatroz, Osório - RS, 95520-000

items.information:
**Português**
Valor de inscrição será de R$40,00 a ser pago via pix para **guriopen@gmail.com** (enviar o comprovante para o mesmo e-mail).

Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores.
O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar.

É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**English**
Registration fee is R$40,00 and payment with PIX method, to the key **guriopen@gmail.com** (send the receipt to this e-mail)

Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect.
The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating.

Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
